# Assets · Logos

2 files under `assets/Logos/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for brachio-app-icon.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

`brachio-app-icon.svg` is the app icon: the mint brachiosaurus (`#98E0BF`) on a charcoal squircle (`#1F1F24`). `brachio-mark.svg` is the mascot alone in mint with charcoal eyes cut out, for the first-run empty state and the favicon. Use them as they are: no outlines, no recoloring, no mouth.
